When you write a mission statement, you can use the Future Conditional, Future Continuous tense and sequencing connectors.
The Future Conditional describes what you think you will do in a specific situation in the future. If clauses are used to describe or forecast a likely result.

Example:
    If my word means nothing, then I will never become the man I wish to be.
You use the Future Continuous tense to talk about something happening at a particular time in the future.
The action will have started before that moment but it will not have finished at that moment.
Starting from day one , I will be exercising the virtues of honesty and integrity in all my endeavors and will be thinking about making my future goals a reality.
From the outset, I will be focusing on academics while developing friendships both in the classroom and during extracurricular activities.

You use words or phrases to organize ideas in a piece of writing.
Discourse markers show how ideas are connected. They usually come at the beginning of a sentence.
Discourse markers can show a connection to what the writer is saying and what was just written. They can also show what the writer's opinion is about what is being discussed.

Example:

    Furthermore, I will always be held accountable for my words and actions.
Also, Instead of taking for granted those who have helped me get to this point in my life, I will give back to my friends, family and community.

Instructions:
You need to prepare to write a personal mission statement to complete a college application.
Step 1: Identify past success. Write down 5 examples where you had personal success. It could be at work, at home or in the community.
Step 2: Develop a list of attributes that describe your personality and what your priorities are. For example: empathetic, dedicated, hard-working, selfless, and honest
Step 3: Make a list of the ways you could help others and make a difference in the world. How could you contribute best to your family, your employer or future employers, your friends, your community
Step 4: List the goals you want to achieve in 3-5 years.

images.text:
I need to include a mission statement in my college application. What motivates me?
Well...here goes…

It is my mission to graduate with honors from Northwestern University with a Bachelor's Degree in Business. Firstly, as a hard-working, dedicated and disciplined student, I will commit myself to excellence, and never settle for anything less than my best work.  Starting from day one, I will be exercising the virtues of honesty and integrity in all my endeavors and will be thinking about making my future goals a reality. From the outset, I will be focussing on academics while developing friendships both in the classroom and during extracurricular activities. However, I believe that strong academic results are only part of becoming a successful global citizen. If a person in authority explains their viewpoint, I will respect their position.  Similarly, when the time comes, I will demonstrate that authority when necessary and expect the same in return.  When difficult situations arise, I will always maintain a positive attitude towards my work and those around me that need encouragement.

Also, instead of taking for granted those who have helped me get to this point in my life, I will give back to my friends, family and community. Moreover,  I'm also looking forward to being the kind of student who contributes not only to the growth of the institution, but also to the growth of under-privileged members of society. Furthermore,  I will always be held accountable for my words and actions. If my word means nothing, then I will never become the man I wish to be. An institution such as Northwestern,  which is willing to fuel my ambitions and desire for success is the kind of institution I want to belong to. Finally,  I believe that if I work hard and believe in myself, the world will open its doors.
How do you write a personal mission statement?
